relationship.original_equation: Combined tax rate = 1 - (1 - corporate tax rate) × (1 - dividend tax rate)
relationship.locator: Section II, Combined Nominal Tax Burden
relationship.translation_notes: Rates are base-one fractions. The complement of the public source’s after-tax fraction is the combined tax fraction.
